Definition: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
BiblicalUsage: 1) ear, as part of the body; 2) ear, as organ of hearing; 3) (subjective) to uncover the ear to reveal; the receiver of divine revelation
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
